nodes.name: MCP Server Trigger
nodes.notes: ADR-055 Block 5.2 — self-hosted image MCP server. Hosts one tool, generate_image, that the Managed Agents harness calls in-harness (Block 5.1: agent.mcp_tool_use, no client pause) once the agents register this endpoint with permission_policy=always_allow (Block 5.3). Endpoint: https://agents.haxe.ai/mcp/haxe-image-gen (SSE). Auth: bearer via the 'Image MCP bearer (ADR-055)' n8n credential (httpBearerAuth, id mTlnNTCynGhQtYMO); the same token is in Supabase Vault (get_image_mcp_bearer(), migration 036) for rotation + the Block-5.3 Anthropic-Vault mirror. Image generation is identity-neutral so a single service token is correct (ADR-055 §5 — no per-user scope). Block 5.1 confirmed the harness holds a 200s tool call open; the handler caps count/concurrency so the slowest batch stays well under that.

nodes.name: generate_image
nodes.notes: The generate_image MCP tool. Tool params (advertised to the harness via $fromAI): prompt (required), reference_file_ids (optional array of input-image file_ids), count (1-4), aspect_ratio, size, clickup_task_id (the triggering task id, for cost attribution — ADR-057 follow-up). Delegates to Image MCP Tool Handler (v1) (zxY41zZWRbXon2Eq), which resolves reference_file_ids -> signed URLs via agent_input_file_map then runs the shared Image Tool Handler (v1) image-gen+upload+cost core. Returns {status, file_ids[], message, count_*, warnings[]}; the agent embeds the file_ids in its output. reference_file_ids is JSON.stringify'd into the handler's reference_file_ids_json string input. clickup_task_id is the ONLY channel to attribute image cost to a task: the n8n MCP Server Trigger does not expose inbound headers/body to the handler (Block 5.1), so the harness-passed (agent-supplied) tool arg is the only way the task id can reach the cost writer.

parameters.description: Generate one or more images from a text prompt and return their file_ids. Use this when the user asks for an image, illustration, picture, graphic, or visual. Always pass clickup_task_id (the id of THIS task, given in your message) so the image cost is billed to the right task. Optionally pass reference_file_ids (file_ids of input images already attached to this task) to visually anchor the generation. Returns file_ids you must embed in your output to show the images.

value.prompt: ={{ $fromAI('prompt', 'The text description of the image to generate (English or Polish).', 'string') }}
value.reference_file_ids_json: ={{ $fromAI('reference_file_ids', 'Optional JSON array string of input-image file_id strings to anchor the generation, e.g. ["file_abc"]. Omit if there are none.', 'string', '') }}
value.count: ={{ $fromAI('count', 'Optional number of images to generate, 1 to 4 (default 1).', 'number', 1) }}
value.clickup_task_id: ={{ $fromAI('clickup_task_id', 'REQUIRED for cost accounting. The ClickUp task id of THIS task, shown in your message under the heading that starts with Identyfikator zadania ClickUp. Copy it exactly as given; do not invent one and do not use a different task id.', 'string', '') }}
